name: Mechanical Golem
languages: understands one language known by its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The golem is immune to any spell or
effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The golem has advantage on saving
throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text:
The golem deals double damage to
objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one
target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Chest Cannon (Recharge 6)
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +6
to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6)
bludgeoning damage. Hit or miss, the target and each
creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 14
Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a
failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
